name: c-trace-20
title: Identity verification
description: KYC results for an applicant, where the rejected document opens to its reason and a request for another.

"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { Trace, TraceCollapsible, TraceCollapsibleContent, TraceCollapsibleTrigger, TraceDescription, TraceIcon, TraceLine, TraceTitle, } from "@/components/ui/trace" import { IconPlaceholder } from "@/app/(create)/components/icon-placeholder" // Asking for a new document turns the failure into a pending step, since the // case stays open until the applicant replies. export function Pattern() { const [screened, setScreened] = React.useState(false) const [requested, setRequested] = React.useState(false) const addressTrigger = React.useRef(null) React.useEffect(() => { const timer = window.setTimeout(() => setScreened(true), 2400) return () => window.clearTimeout(timer) }, []) function requestDocument() { setRequested(true) // The button sits in the panel it replaces, so focus goes back to the row. addressTrigger.current?.focus() } return (
Verified the passport chip and MRZ match Matched the selfie to the photo 97% similar {screened ? "Screened sanctions and PEP lists" : "Screening sanctions and PEP lists"} {screened ? no matches : null} {requested ? "Waiting for a new proof of address" : "Rejected the proof of address"} {requested ? "requested just now" : "too old"}
{requested ? (

Jordan was emailed a link to upload a recent one.

) : ( <>

The utility bill is from June 2, and policy needs one from the last 90 days.

)}
{/* Rows change in place, so the two changes a reviewer waits for are also announced. */}

{requested ? "New proof of address requested" : screened ? "Screening finished, no matches" : ""}

) }
